preconditions.description: The number of flowers (n) and suggested subarrays (m) are within bounds 1 to 100.

preconditions.expression: all(-100 <= a_i <= 100 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each flower's mood (a_i) is an integer between -100 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i <= r_i <= n for l_i, r_i in subarrays)
preconditions.description: Each subarray is defined by valid indices (l_i, r_i) where 1 ≤ l_i ≤ r_i ≤ n.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible happiness value achievable by selecting any subset of the suggested subarrays.

postconditions.expression: max_happiness == sum(a[i] * count for i in range(n)) where count = sum(1 for l, r in chosen_subarrays if l <= i+1 <= r)
postconditions.description: The happiness is computed as the sum over all flowers of their mood multiplied by the number of chosen subarrays they are included in.

postconditions.expression: chosen_subarrays is a subset of subarrays
postconditions.description: The chosen subarrays are a subset of the m suggested subarrays.
